intro.text: A burly taskmaster on the Tresting plantation.

items.text: Lord Tresting, unsettled by a defiant skaa who seemed to vanish from his fields, told Kurdon to work that section harder and beat a few skaa at random. Kurdon did so without a second thought, caring nothing for the skaa.
That night, Kelsier killed Kurdon, Tresting and the rest of the plantation's staff while rescuing Jess's daughter, and burned the manor down.
